literal_meaning: চড় মারা বা গালে চাপড় দেওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: to scold severely or reprimand harshly
similar_in_english: give someone a piece of one's mind
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাবা ছেলেকে গেদে দিয়ে শিক্ষা দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: The father gave his son a severe scolding for his mischief.
The teacher reprimanded the student harshly in front of the class.
note: This idiom draws from physical punishment metaphors common in Bengali folk expressions.
